references.text: This verse contains the original instruction from God to make twenty boards for the south side of the tabernacle, as Exodus 36:23 describes their execution.
The entire passage gives God's detailed instructions about the boards for the tabernacle, which the craftsmen now carry out in chapter 36.
Here the tabernacle and its boards are mentioned as part of the work to be done, pointing forward to the actual construction in 36:23.
The Levites were given responsibility for caring for the tabernacle's boards (קְרָשִׁים), the same boards that were made in Exodus 36:23.
Describes the responsibility of Kohath's sons to carry the tabernacle's boards during the wilderness journey.
